$comment: Conformance traceability manifest (#245). Each requirement row maps a normative clause to its observable conformance assertion and the tests that drive it. Validated by scripts/check-conformance-manifest.mjs: unknown anchors, stale requirement text, duplicate IDs, and missing tests fail CI; rows with no tests are reported as TODO (the reverse mapping), never silently passed. A row's `observation.local` records this implementation's chosen behavior where the spec permits more than one; a local pin never becomes the protocol requirement. Rows whose `applicability` names an optional capability apply only where the deployment claims it: a runner MUST NOT mark an unclaimed capability nonconforming, and a failed SHOULD row is a recorded departure, not a hard fail.

requirements.text: The AS MUST reject with `invalid_request` a `mission_intent` presented on a front-channel authorization request that does not use a PAR-issued `request_uri`

observation.normative: authorization request carrying mission_intent without a PAR-issued request_uri fails invalid_request

requirements.text: a `mission_intent` submitted outside the Request Object in the same push MUST be rejected with `invalid_request`

observation.normative: push carrying a Request Object plus a mission_intent outside it fails invalid_request

requirements.text: refusing a submission that exceeds the deployment-defined limits with `invalid_request`

observation.normative: submission exceeding a declared envelope, Intent, array, or evidence bound fails invalid_request

tests: src/services/authorization-server/test/submission-envelope.test.ts :: bounds the entry COUNT (config default, overridable)
src/services/authorization-server/test/submission-envelope.test.ts :: bounds the per-entry SIZE (config default, overridable)
requirements.notes: Evidence count and per-entry bounds are driven; the Intent-size branch (MAX_INTENT_BYTES, kernel intent.ts) is untested at the wire and is the TODO in core.submission.size-bounds-intent.

requirements.text: The AS MUST bound the Submission envelope's total size, the Intent's total size and the lengths of its arrays

observation.normative: Intent exceeding the deployment size limit fails invalid_request at the wire

requirements.text: the AS MUST ignore any `mission_intent`, `authorization_details`, `scope`, or `resource` presented, and MUST NOT let such a value widen the authority derived from the pushed parameters

observation.normative: widened mission_intent, authorization_details, scope, or resource beside the request_uri on the authorization request neither affects approval rendering nor widens issued authority

requirements.text: an object carrying duplicate member names is rejected at parse time, before the parsed data model exists

observation.normative: input destined for commitment carrying duplicate JSON member names is rejected before canonicalization; last-value-wins is foreclosed

tests: src/services/authorization-server/test/submission-envelope.test.ts :: strict parse: duplicate member names in the envelope are refused

requirements.text: A verifier MUST reject a digest whose algorithm prefix it does not recognize

observation.normative: an anchor with an unrecognized algorithm prefix is rejected, never treated as sha-256

tests: src/packages/mission-core/test/anchors.test.ts :: verifyAnchor round-trips and rejects unknown algorithm prefixes

requirements.text: An AS MUST reject `max_derivations` below 1 with `invalid_request`

observation.normative: controls.max_derivations of 0 or less fails invalid_request
observation.local: kernel test drives the input but asserts a message regex; the invalid_request code is not yet asserted

requirements.text: the AS MUST maintain a per-Mission count of **derivations** and MUST refuse with `invalid_grant` any derivation that would exceed the bound

observation.normative: derivation past controls.max_derivations fails invalid_grant at the token endpoint; failed derivations do not count
observation.local: covered at the kernel gate only; no wire test observes invalid_grant for exhaustion

tests: src/services/authorization-server/test/kernel.test.ts :: gates derivation on state and derivation cap (@spec mission#lifecycle)

requirements.text: the AS SHOULD include, alongside `error`, the `mission_error` token-error-response member

observation.normative: lifecycle refusals carry mission_error with one of mission_revoked, mission_expired, mission_superseded, derivations_exhausted
observation.local: implementation emits mission_denial_reason with the kernel reason set instead; recorded SHOULD-level departure, tracked in #526

requirements.text: an AS whose policy cannot accept the proposed `expires_at` refuses with `invalid_authorization_details` rather than rewriting it

observation.normative: unacceptable proposed expires_at fails invalid_authorization_details; the AS never rewrites the value

requirements.notes: Cross-document contradiction with the Mission Template three-way clamp; no test pins either behavior until #525 resolves.

requirements.text: The mapping is a lookup, never synthesis; the AS refuses an Intent that matches no configured mapping with `invalid_authorization_details`

observation.normative: in configured-mapping (template) mode, an Intent matching no configured mapping fails invalid_authorization_details, distinguishable from a policy refusal

requirements.notes: Core configured-mapping mode, not the Mission Template companion; the companion's unknown template_id error is specified and tested separately.

requirements.text: an AS MUST NOT derive Mission-bound authority from a client-supplied `mission_id`

observation.normative: a client-supplied mission_id cannot select or alter the Mission used for derivation; if the request is accepted, the emitted Mission is the grant-bound Mission (rejecting the unexpected parameter also conforms)

requirements.text: A credential the Mission Issuer derives MUST have an `exp` that does not exceed the Mission's `expires_at`

observation.normative: no derived credential's exp exceeds the Mission's expires_at

tests: src/services/authorization-server/test/async-delegation.test.ts :: absolute-lifetime clamp: the initial access token exp never exceeds the Mission expires_at

requirements.text: The AS MUST NOT issue a Mission-bound token whose `scope` exceeds the Authority Set

observation.normative: every issued scope value corresponds to authority present in authorization_details; no issued token carries scope beyond the Authority Set

requirements.text: the AS MUST return `active: false` and include `mission.state` giving the reason

observation.normative: a valid token on a revoked or expired Mission introspects as active: false plus mission.state
observation.local: provider currently returns bare {active:false} with no mission member; red-first tests and the paired fix are #526

requirements.text: MUST return Mission data only to a caller authorized to receive it

observation.normative: an unauthenticated, unauthorized, or wrong-audience caller receives no Mission detail
observation.local: no audience filtering exists in the handler; red-first tests and the paired fix are #526
